artifact_type: Independent net-profit, orders and costs UX reconstruction

implementation.author: kasrapmb
implementation.data: 180 deterministic fictional orders and 120 daily store cost records
implementation.stores: Shopify and Amazon are fictional store labels; no integrations
implementation.currency: USD; integer cents throughout the financial ledger
implementation.storage: Only user-added expenses persist in origin-scoped localStorage

accounting_model.netProfit: revenue - cogs - shippingCost - paymentFees - fulfillment - ads - operating - customExpense
accounting_model.tax: Pass-through sample tax excluded from revenue and profit
accounting_model.refund_costs: No automatic COGS recovery, fee reversal or restocking credit
accounting_model.allocation: Deterministic equal integer-cent allocation across eligible orders on each date and store; all-store expenses use all orders on that expense date

skill.name: reverse-engineer-anything
skill.usage: Evidence boundaries and independent reconstruction workflow; no connected REA MCP, original-source recovery or REA Evidence IDs claimed.
